attributes.comment: Difficulty getting started second attempt I received the crash message. The first attempt I just got a black screen with waiting which I can send you a copy of if you want it. I did take a screenshot as suggested wishing you good luck. Look forward to seeing improvement.

So the first time I tried the app it did a good greeting and it got me set up and then it seemed to have problems when both my son and I were trying to talk to it at the same time. It froze up and wouldn’t respond after that.
This go around it’s just me in the room middle background noise it says hello and ask me how my day is and when I respond it says it’s thinking and then nothing happens except for this crash I tried turning off my Bluetooth thinking it was trying to connect to my AirPods, which are in their case, and that seemed to be the precursor for the crash

System crashed after trying to text.  It was not responding to my text message and then crashed

Other item I noticed I changed my avatar to a male however when texting it had the original avatar on top left of iPhone
Stopped listening, switched to chat, stopped answering. After a about a min typed in chat again, it responded and immediately crashed afterwards
Doesn’t recognize speech then crashes after one response in chat
Hard crash after playing a voice line after coming back from background
Won’t stop talking. Gets in a never ending loop. Also app quit unexpectedly
